paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of several large language models (LLMs) on the MATH-500 and AIME24 datasets. The horizontal axis represents the model size or identifier, with categories including “3B,” “unk,” “405B,” “1.5B,” “671B,” and “7B,” and the vertical axis represents performance scores, labeled from 0 to 100 with a linear scale and tick intervals of 10. Each set of three bars represents a comparison for one dataset–MATH-500 and then AIME24. Within each set, the bars are grouped by model: CoT (white), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue), Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (orange), TTS (brown), GPT-4o (dark purple), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (red), o1-mini (light purple), o1-preview (dark red), DeepSeek-R1 (yellow), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (gray). For example, in the MATH-500 set, the “3B” bar for CoT reaches approximately 78.2, while the corresponding Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct bar is at 74.6. In the AIME24 set, the “7B” bar for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B extends to 83.3; the tallest bars generally fall between 90 and 97.3. Some bars contain small icons, representing what model is being compared, and the grouping is consistently organized with the same color coding across all chart sets. The bars are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized through shading, outlining, or annotation.
